cards.summary: After months sitting on the sidelines of the frontier AI race, Google has finally launched its long-awaited Gemini 4 Argon model, claiming it can compete with the best the industry has to offer. Google says Argon delivers "frontier reasoning and improved performance across complex workflows," while cutting down on hedging, repetition, and the cliches that continue to plague AI chatbots.
cards.title: Google finally releases Gemini 4 Argon

sources.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents

cards.summary: Shopify announced Tuesday it will let shoppers configure their AI agents to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopify's catalog. (The catalog consists of both items on and off Shopify storefronts.) In September, Shopify announced it was partnering with Meta to allow its Muse agent to browse and purchase items on a human's behalf; now, shoppers can use any agent without a partnership integration.
cards.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents

sources.title: Facebook will let you customize your feed algorithm using AI

cards.summary: Facebook's new "Your Algorithm" feature will let you directly add and manage topics you want to see in your feed and Facebook Reels. Meta says your recommendations "respond right away" after you make updates using the new feature by hitting "interested" or "not interested" for different topics.
cards.title: Facebook will let you customize your feed algorithm using AI

sources.title: Epic shifts to ‘AI-accelerated development’ for upcoming Disney game

cards.summary: Epic Games plans to use AI to generate code and art for an unannounced Disney game, which is now delayed from its original March release window, according to a report from Bloomberg . The project's developers have been given an "AI-first" mandate directing them to use tools like Anthropic's Claude more to finish the game.
cards.title: Epic shifts to ‘AI-accelerated development’ for upcoming Disney game

cards.summary: An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company said it discovered a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in one of its offices. The employee was identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national.

sources.title: Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports

cards.summary: Microsoft has witnessed skateboarding being modded into Call of Duty and Halo being played in a web browser , and the company is now officially embracing the chaos of this new AI-powered era of game modding. Microsoft is putting together a new Xbox Labs group to explore the rapid emergence of these mods, many of which use AI models to help modders remix games in ways we've rarely seen before.
